articles.title: A Berkeley scientist spent more than a decade listening to zebra finches

This could revolutionize human perspectives on interspecies dialogue, promoting reciprocal understanding. Nevertheless, fully unraveling avian communication remains a complex, ongoing research endeavor for many scientists.
